messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-03-03, the auth gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-03]
- On 2026-05-22, team Dune noticed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-2]
- As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour, because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, which the Cinder team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: The Cinder team owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03-2]
- On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, team Dune still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- The Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate rise and pinged the authentication gateway's owners. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: Since 2025-03-07, the billing API is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the authentication gateway handover document for Diego. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
- Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-29]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-18 to 2025-12-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-18]
- Per policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-07-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-07-29]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-12-05, the Ember team owns reporting, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]

Question: Who owns auth-gateway today?

message.reasoning: Handover 2025-09-16: Ember handed auth gateway to Cinder. The old entry says Ember owns it (valid 2025-01-20 to now) but the handover supersedes. Answer: Cinder team.
